title: main-ref's stale origin/main case passes on every git version
why: c159's lane (Oct 28): githooks/main-ref/test_hook.sh case "fetch origin main:main, origin/main stale" is red on untouched main e0f9e2d under git 2.43 (cloud container): the hook refuses "<sha> is not on origin/main". CI (gates.yml line 420) passes it, so the guard's verdict depends on the git version.
note: Debt. Guess, unmeasured: a non-atomic fetch updates each ref in its own transaction, so the hook sees main move before origin/main does. Next cloud lane: read CI's git version, reproduce on 2.43, fix the reference-transaction hook logic so both versions agree; red first on today's case. Needs no answer. Port: no; the guard installs from claude-settings. Placed ahead of c107 (triage, Oct 28): a guard that refuses a correct fetch blocks work.
